scientific_integrity: Complete explicit first-four-position combinatorial proof and integral graph cycle bases; independent finite prefix/permutation scripts corroborate, rather than replace, the infinite argument.
scientific_limitations: The universal homotopy calculation is for the unfilled one-dimensional graph and vertex-order-induced full strong matchings only; equivariant classification is of integral homology, not equivariant homotopy. The order-four case was previously established; the new infinite extension has not been independently audited. Unindexed earlier literature remains a possible overlap risk.
title: A sharp two-edge transition in strong-Morse complexes of near-complete graphs
